title: Launch Orchestra Playbook and Capacity Simulation Sprint
creator: Amira Chen
description: Problem: We lack a repeatable operations playbook that combines stakeholder orchestration with an empirical capacity simulation to predict regional contention during multi-product launch windows. Goal: Deliver a lightweight 'Launch Orchestra' playbook plus a capacity-simulation runbook and a small simulation harness that product, eng, and SREs can run to validate launch plans. Outcomes: 1) Playbook PDF with roles/responsibilities, communication cadences, cutover gates, and fallback lanes; 2) Simulation harness (capacity-sim) that models request-mix, regional failover and grace-period throttles to estimate latency and queue growth for a candidate launch; 3) Post-launch checklist and dashboard template for Console to monitor signal health. Acceptance criteria: - Playbook reviewed and approved by Eng, SRE, and Legal - Capacity-sim prototype runs with three scenarios (nominal, peak, fail-over) and produces latency and tokens/sec projections - Runbook includes clear rollback/on-call triggers and escalation matrix - At least two PM/SE teams use the simulation for an upcoming runtime/console/api launch Approach: - Week 1: Align stakeholders and gather historical traffic profiles from Console and runtime telemetry. - Week 2: Build a small Go-based simulator with configurable request mixes and backend capacity parameters; create canonical scenarios. - Week 3: Run simulations, refine playbook, and iterate on cutover gates. - Week 4: Run a cross-team dry-run and finalize deliverables. Stakeholders: PMs (Amira, Ravi), Engineering leads (Liam, Sofia), SRE (Diego), Design (Nina), Legal & Compliance reviewers. Success metrics: - Simulation predicts within 20% of observed post-launch token throughput in a shadow run - Playbook adoption by at least two launches in Q2 - Time-to-detect for critical signal during launch reduced by 30% Artifacts & links: - Simulation repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/launch-sim - Draft playbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LaunchOrchDraft - Telemetry query examples (Console): https://console.redwood-inference.internal/queries/launch-readiness - Related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-sim/pull/256 Risks & mitigations: - Risk: historical telemetry incomplete for APAC region. Mitigation: use conservative headroom and coordinate with cloud provider for region-level capacity estimates. - Risk: teams skip dry-run. Mitigation: make simulation runnable with a one-click script and require run evidence in launch checklist.
